slides.title: AI News Cache-to-Cache Direct Semantic Communication Between LLMs
slides.text: AI News Cache-to-Cache Direct Semantic Communication Between LLMs Problem: Text-based communication between language models loses rich internal information and adds delays through sequential token generation Solution: Cache-to-Cache (C2C) uses trained neural adapters to project and fuse models’ key-value caches, transferring semantic representations without intermediate text. Both models remain frozen during adapter training. Achievement: The revised paper reports 6.4–14.2% higher accuracy than individual models and average 2.5-fold speedup over text communication. Importance: Enables faster, richer collaboration across different model families and sizes. https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.03215 https://github.com/thu-nics/C2C

slides.title: AI News Discord rewriting its apps into Rust
slides.text: AI News Discord rewriting its apps into Rust Desktop app - from Electron Mobile app - from React Native The new "Discord Phoenix" is built on GPUI, the Rust UI framework from the team behind the Zed code editor New Rust app takes less memory ( 290MB vs 856MB ) No release date yet Rust: Origins and Birthday Graydon Hoare, a Canadian programmer working for Mozilla in Vancouver, Canada, started Rust as a personal project in 2006 His goal was to improve on C++ development by combining fast systems programming with stronger memory safety and concurrency protections Mozilla began sponsoring Rust in 2009; the project became public and openly developed in 2010 Rust 1.0, its first stable release, arrived May 15, 2015 May 15 is therefore celebrated as Rust’s birthday Its importance lies in making reliable, high-performance software easier to build while preventing many memory-related bugs https://www.rust-lang.org/ https://blog.rust-lang.org/2019/05/15/4-Years-Of-Rust/

slides.title: AI News Profits of selling information go down.
slides.text: AI News Profits of selling information go down. Example: Stack Overflow https://stackoverflow.com/questions The number of monthly questions was falling from approximately 207,000 in March 2014 to 966 in September 2026 Mostly because people switched to using AI assistants. So now it is difficult to sell "how-to" information. You need to sell something else. You can sell stories. You can sell implementation (build the house instead of "how to build" You can sell human connection - "community" solutions.

slides.title: AI News AI Compression: Quality vs Speed CompressionBench
slides.text: AI News AI Compression: Quality vs Speed CompressionBench paper from Carnegie Mellon University, PA 6 agents each received 8 hours on one H200 NVL GPU to compress models and implement inference; 29 of 36 submissions passed verification. Sonnet 5.5 compressed Qwen3.8-27B within 8 GiB, achieving 68.67% accuracy versus an expert release’s 65.33%. However, its speed fell from 75 to 23 tok/sec Agents improved quality per byte, not speed. The budget excludes KV cache https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06858 [ https://github.com/Infini-AI-Lab/Compression-Bench](https://github.com/Infini-AI-Lab/Compression-Bench) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xVJoOdlF7-E

slides.title: AI Trading Robinhood Trading - Manual & Agentic
slides.text: AI Trading Robinhood Trading - Manual & Agentic Automatic does not mean profitable or dependable. Robinhood warns that agents can misunderstand instructions, use outdated information, and lose your entire investment. You remain responsible for their trades. External MCP accounts currently default to approvals off, unlike built-in agents. Approval controls are still rolling out for external accounts. https://robinhood.com AI Trading: Uses and Limits Today As of today, AI can assist pricing, hedging, and risk analysis; but it cannot guarantee consistently profitable autonomous trading. AI helps analyze information and improve execution efficiency U.S. securities firms use AI for investment research, portfolio management, and trading execution; FINRA, the U.S. industry regulator, monitors adoption. (FINRA = Financial Industry Regulatory Authority) https://www.finra.org/rules-guidance/key-topics/fintech/report/artificial-intelligence-in-the-securities-industry/ai-apps-in-the-industry https://www.finra.org/rules-guidance/key-topics/artificial-intelligence https://www.finra.org/investors/insights/artificial-intelligence-and-investment-fraud TL;DR - reliability requires validated data, independent testing, trading limits, and human oversight. General-purpose chatbots can hallucinate; institutional machine-learning systems are distinct from chatbots. Treat “guaranteed returns” as a warning sign

slides.title: AI News Superhuman AI Is Forecasted for 2027
slides.text: AI News Superhuman AI Is Forecasted for 2027 METR’s estimate that Anthropic’s AI progress runs roughly twice its historical pace 35–65% probability to AI capable of automating all white-collar work in 2027 Alignment is lagging, recursive self-improvement could amplify misalignment, and China could steal training recipes or weights https://ai-futures.org https://blog.aifutures.org/p/q35-timelines-update-looks-like-the Fable 5.2: New Prompting Rules Fable 5.2 delivers Opus 5.5-level coding performance at half the cost using high effort. So - use high effort initially; reserve extra-high for harder tasks; avoid costly maximum settings Require tests, evidence, and explicit completion criteria to counter unsupported claims and unfinished work Simplify outdated instructions, clarify code ownership, and let the model choose when to delegate subagents Request occasional progress updates Specify tone and length separately from effort https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c_McosB62a4

slides.text: AI News Runway Praxis-1: a 27B open-weight robotics model 27B parameters, released under Apache 2.0 Predicts both video and robot actions Tops NVIDIA's RoboLab-120 leaderboard at 46.2% success across 1,200 episodes Weights on GitHub and Hugging Face Supports full fine-tuning and LoRA on NVIDIA hardware Can be adapted to different robot bodies https://runway.com/news/company-news/praxis-1-is-now-available MCP vs CLI vs skills: what each costs in context OpenRouter measured token use for the same simple task MCP with default tools used 59,417 tokens A CLI used 1,421 A skill used 3,315 MCP servers add thousands of input tokens to every request through tool definitions Tool Search defers those definitions and cuts the upfront cost to under 600 tokens Tool-heavy MCP setups are the expensive choice unless definitions load on demand https://openrouter.ai/blog/insights/mcp-vs-cli-vs-skills/

slides.title: AI News How AI Models Learn to Reason
slides.text: AI News How AI Models Learn to Reason Reinforcement learning (RL) turns text predictors into better reasoners by rewarding successful solutions and discouraging failures Anthropic researcher Jeremy Berman explains the process to Matthew Berman, using apartment prices, Python, PyTorch, and Qwen demo-s. Neural networks adjust numerical weights to reduce prediction errors; pre-training teaches language patterns, while post-training develops assistant behavior Assistants can confidently produce incorrect answers. RL helps - practice verifiable tasks, compare attempts, and reinforce better reasoning https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Sjdvu4nHfDk https://colab.research.google.com MedGraph: Time-Aware AI Memory https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08433 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MPlg31ZhrQo MedGraph improved medical dialogue accuracy by 10.5 percentage points Donghua Zhang and colleagues at Michigan, Georgetown, Johns Hopkins, and Harvard universities, USA, introduced the research prototype It tackles outdated records, confusion between patients and relatives, and missing safety information Three layers preserve original conversations, organize dated clinical facts into temporal chains , and supply patient profiles containing every recorded safety fact Unlike basic retrieval, it assembles patient-specific histories reflecting the requested time without retraining model weights
